scenicChapters.title: Rosenheim fuel → Chiemsee shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 31 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

chiemgau-alpine-edges-and-munich-bavaria.story: 643 km from Rosenheim to Isen, about 12 h 04 of riding. On the way it passes Chiemsee shore, Aschau mountain view, Miesbach  roads and near Isen. The climbs: in Peißenberg, near Miesbach and Scenic stretch in Bruckmühl. It tops out at about 1,000 m. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.

places-cova-de-rull-mas-d-en-badenes.story: 69 km from Albocàsser to Albocàsser, about 1 h 11 of riding. On the way it passes Barranc del Puig- Abric I, mas d'en Badenes and back through Barranc del Puig- Abric I. The highest point is about 1,250 m. The line favours views over speed.
